# F09a

Synthetic statistics fixture; derived, unsigned, never a headline.

Construction: Deliberately corrupted series; symbolic NaN injection. Seed: none (deterministic).

Exception to the valid-input integer shape: the first return is the JSON string 'NaN'. It must refuse as corrupted input. F09a-guards.json specifies actual NaN, +Infinity, and a Pearson-violating moment set as symbols to be materialised by a test. No nonstandard JSON number is written. Each guard is also tested via a compute call with an actual NaN element; this is a guard test, not a valid signed series.

The stored e8 integers are authoritative. Design targets are construction goals, not expectations. Expectations come exclusively from the independent stdlib oracle using SPEC-03 E1–E15. The integers use round-to-nearest, ties-to-even.
